note: KOA Resort in Chula Vista on the south bank of the Sweetwater River channel, 15 minutes from downtown San Diego: rows of RV sites under shade trees, cabins and glamping tents, a year-round pool and hot tub, cafe, jumping pillows, dog park and a full-time activities program. A popular winter base, with extended-stay rates from September through June. --Claude
